standard_prerequisites.name: The characterisation of separated, quasi-separated, quasi-DM and DM morphisms of algebraic stacks by the corresponding property of the diagonal
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 1885-1889)
standard_prerequisites.use: Converts the property of the morphism into a property of the diagonal, which is what the displayed cartesian square tests.

standard_prerequisites.name: The description of the Isom sheaf of two objects over a common test space as a fibre product of the double fibre product, and stability of the properties under base change
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof (source lines 1892-1897)
standard_prerequisites.use: Exhibits the morphism of the second assertion as a base change of the morphism of the first.

core_obligations: First assertion: the proof observes that the displayed square comparing the fibre product of the two test spaces over the source with their fibre product over the target is cartesian, so the required property follows from the diagonal characterisation of the hypothesis (proof lines 1877-1889)

Second assertion: the proof writes the Isom sheaf as a fibre product of the double fibre product of the test space with itself along the diagonal, which exhibits the morphism of the second assertion as a base change of the morphism of the first (proof lines 1892-1897)
proof_roadmap: (1) 观察 T_1 ×_{x_1,X,x_2} T_2 → T_1 ×_{y_1,Y,y_2} T_2 的方形图是笛卡尔的，于是由「f 分离/准分离/quasi-DM/DM ⟺ 对角线 proper/准紧且准分离/局部准有限/非分歧」立得。
(2) 用 Isom_X(x_1,x_2) = (T ×_{x_1,X,x_2} T) ×_{T×T, Δ_T} T 把 (2) 的映射写成 (1) 的基变换。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement records that for a separated, quasi-separated, quasi-DM or DM morphism of algebraic stacks the comparison map between the fibre products of two test spaces and the comparison map between the two Isom sheaves inherit the corresponding property, in four variants at once (author lemma at source lines 1851-1874, label lemma-separated-implies-isom). The proof (source lines 1876-1898) identifies the relevant square as cartesian and invokes the diagonal characterisation of the hypothesis for the first assertion, and writes the Isom sheaf as a fibre product exhibiting the second morphism as a base change of the first (proof lines 1877-1897). The two identifications of fibre products are the content. H2.
